name: Acht
source:
Hobbies: Reading, fashion, relaxation
Likes: Secrets
Dislikes: Filth

One of the main antagonists of Code: Embryo and a member of the Ten Sages. Devoted to Sechs, Acht is a confident young woman who is a master of manipulation. Despite being enemies with Kuon and several others, she often gives them helpful advice when they prove their combat prowess to her. She hates the weak and those that whine, finding Touya in particular to be extremely annoying. If someone had thoroughly annoyed her, she would attempt to kill them with her magic; something she is cockily confident in.
